guidance.heading: 2026 Outlook
section: The table below includes the details of our annual guidance as of November 5, 2026 which have been updated to include the projected impacts of the joint venture which closed on August 31, 2026. The Company’s guidance is provided for informational purposes based on current plans and assumptions and is subject to change. The ranges for these metrics do not include the impact of acquisitions, dispositions, or capital markets activity beyond that which has been previously announced.

11/5/2026 | 8/6/2026
Warehouse segment same store revenues (constant currency) | $2.06B - $2.10B | $2.03B - $2.09B
Warehouse segment same store NOI (constant currency) | $680M - $700M | $660M - $695M
Total Company NOI (constant currency) | $800M - $830M | $775M - $815M
Total selling, general and administrative expense (guidance is inclusive of approximately $228M - $233M of core SG&A, $23M - $24M of share-based compensation expense, and $8M - $10M of Project Orion deferred costs amortization) | $260M - $265M | $250M - $260M
Core EBITDA | $585M - $610M | $570M - $600M
Interest expense | $155M - $160M | $155M - $160M
Current income tax expense, excluding impact of EQT Joint Venture | $7M - $9M | $7M - $9M
Total maintenance capital expenditures | $60M - $70M | $60M - $70M
Adjusted FFO per share | $1.31 - $1.33 | $1.26 - $1.32
